names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Ναυκράτιος ο Στουδίτης», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Ναυκράτιος κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 847 μ.Χ.», and its heading has «Οσιος Ναυκρατιος ο Στουδιτης (; - 847)». The page gives no year of birth and dates his election as abbot to 842.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 847)». The corpus holds one folder whose name folds onto this one, Naucratius the brother of Basil the Great, who is of the fourth century and is not this Studite. The page prints no couplet and no hymn.
